caption:
Dividing powers? Subtract, don't divide.

xᵃ / xᵇ = xᵃ⁻ᵇ, and the coefficients divide normally: 12x⁷ / 4x³ = 3x⁴.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: 12x⁷ / 4x³ = 3x⁴. Divide the numbers, subtract the exponents.

youtube.title: Exponent Quotient Rule: 12x⁷ / 4x³ Step by Step
